messages:
lina: Heads-up: prepping RC for convo-service to include a last-minute cherrypick (bugfix for header parsing). aiming for 10:30 PT cut but there9s a short DB check to run. who can own sign-off?

martin: I can drive the cut. what9s the artifact tag?

lina: tag: convo-service@2026-03-23-rc7-cherry

deploy-bot: New candidate created: convo-service@2026-03-23-rc7-cherry (id: cand-3250000000). CI: unit/integration green. Note: contains cherrypick commit 7f3a2b. KV warming recommended.

qa-bot: Starting litmus (smoke + regression set). ETA ~7m.

qa-bot: Litmus initial: 119/120 pass. one formatting mismatch unrelated. tagging examples.

lina: paste the mismatch please so we can triage.

qa-bot: example:
```
input: "Email invoice"
expected: "Invoice total: $100.00"
actual: "Invoice total: $100.00. "
```
minor trailing punctuation, non-blocker.

martin: important: the cherry fixes header charset parsing that affects DB import of legacy rows. ops: can we run the lightweight migration check before pinning?

ops-bot: Scheduling DB precheck job: `./dbctl precheck --cluster=prod-readonly --candidate=cand-3250000000 --quick` Estimated 4m.

deploy-bot: KV-warm recommended. Requesting pin decision after DB check.

infra-monitor: DB precheck started. tailing for key consistency errors.

-- 4m later --

infra-monitor: DB precheck passed: no legacy-key collisions found. latency snapshot normal.

martin: good. propose pin for 90m promo window, reserve rollback slot. Abort rule: sustained error_rate >0.7% for 5m triggers rollback.

release-manager: I pinned the candidate (pin-3250000000) and created ticket RB-9993. Promo window 11:00-12:30 PT to allow a short cool-down.

ops-bot: Candidate cand-3250000000 pinned as pin-3250000000. Radio-silence rule in effect 30m before promo.

lina: final checklist: cherrypick in artifact, litmus pass, db precheck pass, kv-warm pending, rollback playbook linked in RB-9993. Reply with \u2705 to sign off.

martin: \u2705

qa-bot: \u2705

infra-monitor: \u2705

sheriff: \u2705 026A0; monitoring and ready to trigger rollback.

-- 11:05 PT --

deploy-bot: Promotion started for cand-3250000000 -> prod. Rolling out in 5 cohorts.

infra-monitor: Cohort 1 (5%) stable. p95 +2ms.

infra-monitor: Cohort 2 (20%) steady.

martin: starting cohort 3 (50%).

infra-monitor: Cohort 3 shows a small error spike in region-eu at t+90s: spikes in header-parsing errors (new fix surfaced an unexpected legacy header shape). error rate peaked 0.35% then dropped.

sheriff: holding rollout. starting quick mitigation: enable legacy-header-fallback flag in runtime for the candidate. ops?

ops-bot: Applying runtime flag: legacy.header.fallback=true on cand-3250000000. Audit cfg-3250.

infra-monitor: After flag, errors dropped to baseline within 45s. p99 stable.

sheriff: safe to continue from my side.

martin: resume rollout.

deploy-bot: Cohort 4 (80%) promoted. Cohort 5 (100%) starting.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete: cand-3250000000 -> prod :shipit:

lina: Promotion succeeded. Please add a short release note to RB-9993 calling out cherry-pick and the temporary fallback flag.

release-manager: Added note: "convo-service RC7-cherry promoted to prod. Includes header-parsing cherrypick (commit 7f3a2b). Temporarily enabled legacy.header.fallback during rollout to smooth legacy row handling; flag will be removed after 24h verification. No DB migration performed."

lina: thanks everyone. closing thread. :tada:
